cases.case_label: AluYb8 in OPA1 intron 7 causing exon 8 skipping (ADOA)
cases.mechanism_detail: An antisense AluYb8 (289 bp + 25-bp polyA, 17-bp TSD) inserted 21 bp upstream of exon 8 near the acceptor site causes in-frame skipping of exon 8 in patient blood RNA; the authors suggest interference with the branch site.
cases.quote: The Alu insertion was located in intron 7 of OPA1, 21 bp upstream of exon 8, near the acceptor site (C.784–21_22). The mutation caused the skipping of exon 8 in mRNA (Figure 2D,E).
